annotations.title: Find a Los Angeles hotel by name

description: Find hotels in the Los Angeles area by name, former name, brand or city, optionally only those within a few miles of a place. Returns each hotel's name, city and journeyed.org page URL. Use it to get the exact hotel before get_hotel, or to list a brand's hotels near a place. It matches names only: for a need such as parking or pets use hotels_near.

limit.description: How many hotels to return (1 to 10, default 5). The result gives the URL of the full list.

near.description: Optional. Only hotels within a few miles of this place. A Los Angeles area landmark, venue, airport or neighborhood by name, for example "SoFi Stadium", "LAX", "Disneyland", "Santa Monica". list_places gives every place covered.

query.description: Hotel name, former name or brand, with a city if you have one. Examples: "The Anthem", "Marriott", "Hilton Anaheim".

name: search_hotels

total.description: How many hotels matched; hotels[] holds the first `limit`.

title: Find a Los Angeles hotel by name
